title: OutcomeBound scaffold report v1
description: What the scaffold verb prints with `--json`, in each mode: the same record as its text (docs/specs/scaffold/design.md). Every path is relative to the target, in POSIX form. This schema changes only by added optional fields.

verdict.description: plan: PLAN. accept: PASS when each absent file was written, FAIL on a refusal. check: PASS when no marker is left, else FAIL.

summary.description: The first line of the text.

lifecycle.description: The preset and the overlays in canonical order, joined by `+`; absent for a check given none.

from.description: On a move: the lifecycle `--from` named.
The presets, acts and overlays the file's parts come from.

present_at.description: For present: where the part was found, when that is not the planned path.

block.description: For present: the text the plan's parts would add, for the agent to add on the person's yes.

offer.description: For offer: the `--with` value, or the command or template the offer names.

reason.description: For refused: why the write was refused.

status.description: Such as listed, not enforced, or UNVERIFIED, with its reason.

adopt.description: The install command with the fragment selection, quoted for the platform's shell.
